name: Lewis Broerman
headline: Manager - Software Engineer at Arthrex
summary: Expert technical leader with years of experience building applications, leading engineers, and delivering successful integrated projects.  Accustomed to delivering results that exceed client goals and expectations, from inception to execution.  Extensive experience using a cross-disciplinary set of skills to bridge communication gaps between engineering, design, and product resulting in increased efficiency and improved quality.

experience.title: Principal Software Engineer
experience.location: San Diego, California, United States · Remote

• Lead app development from ideation to prototyping to early iterations to production ready

experience.title: Client Engineer
experience.description: Work in a small, 2–3 person team building a 2d/3d client using the Unity engine and C#. Architect and implement game critical features from design specifications working closely with the art team. Developed improved work flows to efficiently implement art heavy features.

experience.title: Technical Lead
experience.description: Work closely with User Experience Group and Business Analyst group to define and understand technical requirements while recommending alternative or improved solutions based on technical limitations.
